quote.translation: "Suppose I meet in the street one day a friend I have not seen for a long time.

quote.translation: There is nothing comic in that situation at all.

quote.translation: But if on that same day I meet him again, and then a third and a fourth time, in the end the two of us will laugh together at the 'coincidence' (符合)" (Bergson, Le rire, p. 91).

regions.text: ergson,Lerire,p91）°これは機起的偶然のたはむれに對する神的徹智のほがらかな笑ひである。

quote.translation: This is the cheerful laughter of divine wisdom at the play of successive contingency.

regions.text: 對する神的徹智のほがらかな笑ひである。然しながら、全く豫期しなかつた友人に往來でひよつ

quote.translation: Yet is it true that running into a friend in the street, quite unexpectedly, "has nothing comic about it at all"?

regions.text: 然しながら、全く豫期しなかつた友人に往來でひよつこり遭ふことはそれ自身「何等の可笑味をも有つてるない」ものであらうか。

quote.translation: Is there not already a "coincidence" in it, and some degree of comic quality?

regions.text: そこに既に「符合」もあり、或度の可笑味もあるのではなからうか。

quote.translation: It must be that the slight comic quality accompanying a simultaneous contingency has grown in geometric progression through successive repetition.

regions.text: きうして同時的偶然に件ふ微小の可笑味が機起的反覆によつて幾何級数約に増大して行つたのでなければなるまい。'以上に於て我々は同時偶然と繼起偶然との關係特に同時的偶然が基礎約意味を有つて機起的偶然の構成に與ることを明かにしたと思ふ。

quote.translation: In the above, I think, we have made clear the relation between simultaneous and successive contingency, and in particular that simultaneous contingency has a basic meaning and takes part in the constitution of successive contingency.

On the basis of this point we could also go on to discuss the presentness that is the temporal character of contingency, but I shall not take that problem up here and leave it until later (see chapter 3, section 9).
